title: Ankara Rules Out 15,000-Strong Deployment to Somalia
excerpt: Asked about reports of a 15,000-strong Turkish force for Somalia, Türkiye's defence ministry said the figure is untrue while its training and advisory mission stays in place.
rank_math_title: Ankara rules out 15,000-strong Somalia deployment | Defence MENA
rank_math_description: Türkiye's defence ministry has dismissed reports of a 15,000-strong deployment to Somalia, saying its mission there remains focused on training and advice.
